headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 20, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a 4-1 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. The Cincinnati Reds dominated the New York Yankees, securing a 10-2 victory. Sal Stewart led the Reds' offense with 2 hits, 6 RBIs, and 4 at-bats. The Toronto Blue Jays secured an 8-6 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Jeff Hoffman earning the win. The San Diego Padres secured a 6-4 victory over the Texas Rangers, with Manny Machado leading the charge at the plate.

Several key players have been affected by injuries, impacting their team's availability. Adley Rutschman, the Baltimore Orioles catcher, has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion, effective retroactive to June 19, 2026. The Los Angeles Dodgers have placed RHP Blake Treinen on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. The Boston Red Sox have placed 2B Isiah Kiner-Falefa on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 19, 2026, due to left forearm inflammation. The Arizona Diamondbacks have placed RHP Michael Soroka on the 15-day injured list due to a left glute strain and LF Jordan Lawlar on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. The Chicago Cubs have acquired right-handed pitcher Jayden Murray from the Houston Astros in exchange for first baseman Cameron Sisneros. The Arizona Diamondbacks have traded SS Luis Urías to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. The Atlanta Braves have traded RHP Hunter Stratton to the Pittsburgh Pirates for C Joey Bart. The Seattle Mariners have traded RHP Randy Dobnak to the Kansas City Royals for cash.
